text:
sara_sales: Heads up team — Received a new RFP from NovaGuard. They want: 4-week POC, completed security questionnaire, capability matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and firm POC pricing. Deadline: next Friday. PDF link uploaded to drive.

maya_solutions: Key asks: HSM integration, EU data residency (eu-west-1), 7-year audit logs, 150 qps target with 2s p95. Recommend we propose a hybrid POC: Hosted EU smoke then Dedicated for scale.

leo_se: I can own runbook + smoke. Proposed POC flow: Day 0-3 onboarding on Hosted EU, Day 4-14 functional tests, Day 15-28 Dedicated scale tests. Need sample corpus, average prompt length, and embedding dim to size Dedicated pool.

rita_security: Security questionnaire notes: we can confirm SOC2, TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest. HSM: cloud KMS and KMIP supported; on-prem HSM requires install window, network peering to control plane, and MSA addendum. 7-year logs > standard retention (1y) — will need legal & cost approval.

maya_solutions: I'll draft a one-page capability matrix that highlights: feature parity, HSM notes, region pinning options, expected latency ranges, and operational caveats (cold start, cache warmup). Client-ready language, please.

leo_se: Sample curl for smoke test to include in runbook: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-13b","prompt":"Summarize: Hello"}'

rita_security: Fallback plan if Private install is delayed: run EU-hosted demo with pinned region + encrypted S3 snapshot of prompts for local replay. Document audit trail and key custody in the runbook.

ops-bot: Note: Dedicated pool provisioning typically 48-72 hours after signed PO. Private installs may take 2-4 weeks depending on site access.

maya_solutions: Pricing guidance: propose temporary dev POC rate (e.g., 40% off gen per-token for duration), committed Dedicated tier pricing matrix, and an add-on fee for extended log retention per TB/month. Billing to finalize numbers.

action items: leo_se -> request 24h trace + sample prompts (today). maya_solutions -> capability matrix draft (tomorrow AM). rita_security -> security questionnaire draft (tomorrow). sara_sales -> coordinate legal on 7yr retention and confirm preferred POC start (today).

sara_sales: If we can circulate drafts by EOD Thursday we can iterate and send Friday. I'll post updates when I hear back from client.
